notes: NY state-chartered bank (standalone entity, not a subsidiary of a separate holding company). Counterparty on Jared 2018 (items 7, 10), Jared 2019 (item 5), and Ivanka NE (items 7, 10). Note: Signature Bank collapsed in March 2023 in the SVB-era bank failures; closed by NYDFS, deposits transferred to Flagstar Bank. The canonical name reflects the entity at the time of disclosure.
